types.description: Provisional generic control transformer with one primary and one secondary winding; voltage ratio and VA are unspecified.

connectionCoverage.notes: Reviewed generic interface: Primary H1/H2 and secondary X1/X2 winding pairs are modeled. Primary H1/H2 are required for the modeled supply. The feeds_internal relation is non-conductive; it does not short either winding or infer a secondary bond. Optional: secondary output use is application-dependent; require both X1/X2 for each used output circuit in project review. Unmodeled: taps, multiple windings, electrostatic shield and frame/bond terminals. Author must select hardware and add voltages, frequency, VA, protection and bonding arrangements. Markings use a generic H/X winding convention, not a manufacturer pinout.
